rubrics.justification: Generally cautious and broadly compatible with a blastocyst assessment, but it overstates visibility of ICM/TE detail from this single soft-focus image and accepts the reported 3AA more than what is directly discernible.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, prior IVF history, BMI, sperm parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with appropriate caveats about morphology and euploidy; only minor overconfidence in image-based morphology limits a perfect score.

Recommendations are largely consistent with standard IVF practice and Gardner-based interpretation, including attention to hydrosalpinx and luteal support; minor issues include somewhat casual mention of alcohol timing and optional testing suggestions without stronger prioritization.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including hydrosalpinx review, luteal support adherence, and future workup, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
